questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: A motorbike is ____ than a bicycle.
questions.explanation: To compare two things with a short adjective, add -er: faster than. We never use more with -er.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: Yesterday we ____ football after school.
questions.explanation: Yesterday is in the past, so the verb takes -ed: played.
Hot ends in one vowel and one consonant, so the t doubles: hotter.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct words: A taxi is ____ than a bus.
questions.explanation: Expensive is long, so the comparative is more expensive than. The most expensive is for one against all the others.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: Last Sunday I ____ to church with my family.

questions.explanation: Bad becomes worse when comparing two things. The worst is the superlative.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct words: The Nyabarongo is ____ river in Rwanda.
questions.explanation: It is compared with all the rivers in Rwanda, so use the superlative: the longest.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: They ____ going to plant trees tomorrow.
questions.explanation: They goes with are: they are going to.

options: This is the most best book in the library.
This is the goodest book in the library.
This is the best book in the library.
questions.explanation: Good is irregular: the best. We never add most to best.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: He would like to ____ a pilot.
questions.explanation: After would like to, use the plain verb: be.
